observations: Car engine and transmission assembly resting on a concrete floor.
V-configuration engine with a prominent black plastic intake manifold.
Extensive wiring harness and various hoses are attached.
A watermark for 'T.I AUTOMOBILE' is visible across the center.
No manufacturer logos, part numbers, or identification plates are legible.

claims.evidence: Requires import documentation or shipping manifests to verify it has not been used locally.

risks.proof: Photo of the engine identification plate or stamped casting numbers.
Video of a compression test or a clip of the engine running.
Inspection of transmission fluid and a video of the input/output shafts being rotated.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate or stamped model code on the block.
Clear photos of the engine from all four sides to check for cracks or missing sensors.
Video showing the engine being turned over manually or a compression test result.
response.reason: The engine's make and model cannot be identified from the photo. In the Lagos market, the value of an engine varies drastically depending on the vehicle it fits; without identification, even a worst-case price cannot be accurately assigned.
